reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 9 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (revenge, streak).
Bottom line: the Raptors win 76 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 199 and 248 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee have lost 13 straight, two shy of the franchise-record skid, but their last five losses were all by 10 points or fewer and Tyler Herro just scored a career-high 50. Toronto snapped a six-game slide on a Scottie Barnes game-winner, but are without Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett (out at least two weeks). The Bucks are competing hard despite the record, so the angle leans slightly towards Milwaukee keeping it close.
